_doc.what_it_is: Catalog of check-environment.py: which skills and tools a project needs according to its areas. The script reads it; Claude uses it to explain the inventory.
_doc.sf_skills_release: Release of sf-skills (forcedotcom/sf-skills) the names were checked against. When sf-skills is updated, run check-environment.py --validate-catalog <skills/ folder of sf-skills> and fix whatever fails.
_doc.method_plugin: Plugin that provides the 'method' skills. They are looked up in that plugin or, failing that, as a standalone copy in the project, parent or user layer. A skill with the same name in another plugin does not count (it is a different skill) and shows up as a warning.
_doc.method: Skills of the plugin itself. They are only checked in the full check (Plan), not with --quick: if the bootstrap is running, the plugin is already installed.
_doc.base: What every project needs: skills and tools. Minimum versions are not written here: they come from metadata.cliTools and metadata.minApiVersion of each skill.
_doc.areas: One entry per area (lowercase ID with hyphens). Fields: description; skills; plugins (optional: plugins that must be installed and enabled); agents (optional: agents that must come in those plugins); tools (optional: tools the area needs even if no skill declares them).
_doc.skill_names: Bare ('platform-soql-query'): looked up in every layer (project, parent, user, plugins). With a plugin ('agentforce-adlc:agentforce-generate'): it only counts if it comes from that plugin; a standalone copy does not replace it.
_doc.criterion: Each area lists only what is needed to build and verify that piece, plus the area's coordination skill if there is one. Missing related skills (metadata.relatedSkills) show up as a warning, not as an error.
_doc.areas_outside_the_catalog: A declared area that is not here is looked up in metadata.domains of the frontmatter of the installed skills, ignoring case, spaces and hyphens ('consumer-goods' = 'Consumer Goods'). It is flagged for review by hand.
_doc.browser: Browser for UI tests (rule M-12): the Playwright MCP that sdd-bootstrap writes into the project's .mcp.json. package and version are pinned on purpose: each version of @playwright/mcp asks for its own Chromium revision (chromium_revision). areas: the areas where the browser is proposed and checked; tools: what it needs on the machine. When the version is raised, update chromium_revision with the one its playwright-core asks for (browsers.json).

agentforce.description: Agentforce agents with Agent Script (.agent): authoring, deployment, preview, functional and security tests, and session observation. Comes from the ADLC plugin.

flow.description: Flows: screen, autolaunched, record-triggered and scheduled.

lwc.description: Lightning Web Components: building and Jest, base components, and security (LWS), accessibility and SLDS checks.

lwr-site.description: Experience Cloud LWR sites through DigitalExperience metadata: pages, routes, views, themes, branding and guest access.

ui-bundle-react.description: React (or Angular) apps as a UI bundle (uiBundles/): project, metadata, frontend, Salesforce data access, the site that hosts them and deployment.

omnistudio.description: OmniStudio (standard runtime): OmniScripts, FlexCards, Integration Procedures, Data Mappers, and dependency and namespace analysis.

data360.description: Data 360 (Data Cloud): DLO and DMO schema, and dataspace access from permission sets.

omni-channel.description: Omni-Channel: base settings, service channel, queues and their routing configuration, members, presence statuses, agent users, permissions, routing flow and sidebar.

digital-engagement.description: Messaging for web and app (MIAW / Enhanced Chat): channel, deployment, widget on the site, agent on the channel and escalation to a human.

messaging-channels.description: Enhanced messaging channels (WhatsApp, SMS, Apple, Facebook, LINE) configured in headless mode: creation, routing, settings and activation.

voice.description: Voice: Agentforce Contact Center channel (number, PstnVoice channel, routing), agent on the channel, and Native Voice recording and transcription.

field-service.description: Field Service: base data (work types, skills, territories, operating hours), scheduling policy with its rules and objectives, and data capture forms for the mobile app.

integration.description: Integration: connected apps and external client apps (OAuth, JWT), named and external credentials, callouts, platform events, Change Data Capture and event subscriptions.

data-model.description: Data model: objects, fields, value sets, validation rules, field reference of standard objects, and test data.

access-security.description: Security and record access: OWD, sharing rules, role hierarchy and permission set assignment to users.

analytics.description: Analytics: Lightning reports, custom report types and CRM Analytics (recipes, datasets and dashboards).

ui-lightning.description: Lightning Experience: apps, tabs, Lightning pages (FlexiPage) and list views.
